caption: The drawing depicts two small, brown, spherical objects resembling walnut shells, each mounted on three short, branch-like legs. The object on the left is shown open, with the upper half of the shell resting above the lower half, which contains a reddish-brown, circular interior. The object on the right is closed, with the two shell halves joined together, forming a complete sphere. Both objects are positioned side by side on a plain, beige background with no additional details or patterns. The artist's signature, "N. Frampona," appears in the lower right section of the drawing. The composition is centered and minimalistic, focusing solely on the two walnut shell objects.
title: Pair of Pin Cushions
